title: Copy of Memory Care Program Manager (Marlton, NJ)
description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Job Summary

The GUIDE Memory Care Program Manager runs the day-to-day operations of Ennoble Care's established Dementia Care Program under the CMS Guiding an Improved Dementia Experience (GUIDE) Model. This role owns the program's administrative and compliance functions and serves as the day-to-day operational and escalation point for the Memory Care Coordinators, and personally carries a portion of the GUIDE patient panel as a Memory Care Coordinator. The Manager ensures ongoing compliance with CMS requirements for interdisciplinary dementia care, standardized service delivery, caregiver support, monitoring, and respite administration — keeping the program running smoothly.

Reports to: Senior Director of Ancillary Programs

Key Responsibilities

Program Operations & Day-to-Day Management

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of Ennoble Care's GUIDE Program — clinical workflows, scheduling, and operational infrastructure.
  • Maintain program workflows and standards aligned with CMS guidelines for standardized care services, interdisciplinary delivery, caregiver support, and care navigation.
  • Own the program's administrative functions day to day, freeing the care coordinators to focus on patient and caregiver care.

Team Support, Supervision & Escalation

  • Supervise and support the Memory Care Coordinators, and serve as their day-to-day operational and escalation point — resolving non-clinical questions and routing clinical concerns to the appropriate provider.
  • Provide coaching, performance evaluation, and ongoing professional development.
  • Triage daily coordinator questions and program issues.

Direct Patient Care (Panel Responsibility)

  • Personally carry a portion of the GUIDE patient panel, serving as the Memory Care Coordinator for those patients.
  • For assigned patients: complete non-clinical assessments, build and maintain person-centered care plans, deliver the required tier-based monthly contacts, provide caregiver support and education, and coordinate respite and community services.
  • Document every contact in a session note and meet the same documentation, contact-cadence, and DCMP billing standards required of the coordinators.

Operational Excellence & Care Delivery Oversight

  • Ensure successful delivery of all standardized GUIDE services, including comprehensive assessments, person-centered care plans, ongoing monitoring, care coordination, medication oversight workflows, social-service referrals, and caregiver support.
  • Direct the team in coordinating community-based supports such as transportation, meals, caregiver programs, and other services outlined in GUIDE.

Respite Services Program Management

  • Oversee the administration of GUIDE respite services, ensuring caregiver awareness, eligibility review, scheduling, and adherence to CMS annual caps.
  • Build and maintain partnerships with in-home providers and adult day centers to ensure access and continuity of offerings.

Compliance, Reporting & Quality Improvement

  • Maintain full compliance with all CMS GUIDE model requirements—including data reporting, documentation standards, beneficiary tiering, and model integrity elements.
  • Develop internal dashboards, KPIs, and QI initiatives to monitor care quality, caregiver strain reduction, service utilization, and program outcomes.
  • Lead root cause reviews, optimize workflows, and implement continuous improvement processes across clinical and operational domains.
  • Own the program's administrative workflows — PAAF / alignment submissions, beneficiary notifications, respite authorizations and invoice / claims administration, and the monthly quality-data (HDR / PROMIS-10 / ZBI-22) submissions.

Beneficiary Identification, Alignment & Enrollment

  • Direct beneficiary identification, referral intake, and the voluntary alignment process — ensuring eligibility requirements are met and maintaining steady enrollment from provider referrals and eligible claims-based lists.
  • Oversee consent workflows and ensure enrollment processes meet CMS standards.

Stakeholder & Community Partnership Development

  • Serve as a key point of contact for CMS reporting and for community-based organizations, memory centers, and health-system partners.
  • Establish collaborative agreements to ensure access to social supports, therapies, caregiver programs, and respite providers.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in nursing, healthcare administration, social work, public health, gerontology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years in dementia care, care coordination, value-based care, or population health, including team-lead or supervisory experience.
  • Proven ability to run day-to-day healthcare program operations and support a care-coordination team.
  • Active clinical license (RN or LPN) preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep knowledge of dementia care, caregiver support models, and interdisciplinary care delivery.
  • Demonstrated success in operational leadership, change management, and process improvement.
  • Strong analytic ability with experience using EMRs, reporting systems, and quality dashboards.
  • Excellent communication, team leadership, and relationship-building skills.

Starting Salary: $65,000–$75,000 per year

title: Chief Estimator - Heavy Civil/Highway
description:
Job Summary

The Chief Estimators primary responsibility is to manage risk for the company by providing oversight and leadership to estimating teams. They are typically involved in multiple projects but may be assigned to a single large project when merited. In addition to having responsibility for the technical success and execution of the projects they work on; they are also responsible for managing the relationships with the other team members. Chief Estimators are ultimately responsible for the quality and timeliness of all estimating deliverables for assigned projects. Day-to-day efforts are focused on management of estimating teams, but individuals will also be asked to develop work products when appropriate or when necessary to manage the flow of work in the department.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Manage the delivery of estimates for projects, providing input, coordination, and problem-solving value at all stages of design development.
  2. A strong design bid build estimating background is necessary. Personnel will develop alternative project delivery experience (P3s, Design Build, CM/GC, and CMAR) if that experience does not currently exist.
  3. Expert level HCSS knowledge including project specific input of labor rates, equipment rates, insurance, bonding, and taxes.
  4. Responsibility for the preparation of accurate and timely estimates on large transportation project bids from start to finish, the lead estimator leads and directs the entire estimating.
  5. Experience working on large, complex transportation and heavy highway projects exceeding 100 million dollars.
  6. Critically analyze bid documents and understand risk and opportunities and articulate those to management.
  7. Define contract risk and establish contract cost exposure and probability due to the identified risk. Propose potential risk mitigation measures and/or recommend reasonable contract contingency.
  8. Thorough understanding of entire project phasing and scope on complex projects with earthwork, structures, paving, and underground work.
  9. Organize estimating team to review plans and specifications, make estimate assignments, and execute overall strategy for winning the bid.
  10. Active participant in reviewing the work of the entire estimating team for compliance with the plans, specifications, and jobsite conditions.
  11. Obtains review and input information from contracts, legal, taxes, insurance, human resources, and other support groups.
  12. Has a strong working knowledge of large construction company cost structures (overheads, G&A, fees, insurances).
  13. Estimate General Conditions and one or more self-perform disciplines.
  14. Experience leading estimates in a Joint Venture environment including writing & following Joint Venture instructions, collaborating with Joint Venture partners, and conducting reviews.
  15. Conducts bid review meeting with the Division Management to confirm cost, finalize bid, and markup/price work.
  16. Select subcontractors and vendors team and closeout the bid. Understand escalation trends for labor and materials.
  17. Develop and maintain successful subcontractor relations. Participate in subcontractor outreach and other Good Faith Efforts that encourage minority participation.
  18. Buy-out projects with ultimate responsibility for budgeting and all subcontracts and purchase orders.
  19. Lead, develop, and mentor other team members and junior estimators. Participates in talent management activities, such as coaching and performance reviews of others.

Minimum Job Requirements

  1. Four‐year engineering degree or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience.
  2. Ten or more years of experience in an estimating role.
  3. Proficient use of all Microsoft Office Suite programs.
  4. Proficient in the use of commonly used industry estimating software programs.
  5. Successful history executing projects as the prime point of contact with minimal oversight for project teams.
  6. Proficient in the use of an Enterprise Project Management Systems.
  7. Proficient in the use of P6 and demonstrates skill in Critical Path Scheduling
  8. Ideal candidates will have project experience in one or more key market sectors identified by the business unit.

Note: Job Description is subject to change at any time and may include other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

1. Ability to wear personal protective equipment is required (including but not limited to; steel toed shoes, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, hardhat, vest, etc.)
2. May reach above shoulder heights and below the waist on a frequent basis
3. May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis
4. May use telephone, computer system, email, or other electronic devices on a limited basis to communicate with internal and external customers or vendors
5. Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures
6. Occasionally will climb stairs, ladders, etc.
7. Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis
8. Will interact with people frequently during a shift/work day
9. Will lift, push or pull objects on an occasional basis
10. Will sit, stand or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift/work day.

Safety Level

Safety-Sensitive

Note: Jobs with the Safety-Sensitive designation are those that include tasks or duties that the employer reasonably believes could affect the safety and health of the employee performing the task or others such as operating a vehicle, operating equipment, operating machinery or power tools, repairing/maintaining the operation of any vehicle/equipment, the handling/disposal/transport of hazardous materials, or the handling/treatment/disposal of potentially flammable/combustible materials.

Position Overview

The purpose of this position is to perform a variety of imaging procedures, including CT and X-Rays, at a technical level not requiring constant supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Provide technical assistance and supportive patient care to assist the physicians, nurses and other technical and administrative staff in meeting the needs of individual patients throughout the facility.

  • Perform all imaging exams in accordance with established policies, procedures, regulations, and laws and ensure the physician on duty is notified of the results
  • Perform basic clinical procedures under the direction of the physician and/or nurse on duty
  • Maintain all required documentation, logs, charts, forms and records in paper and electronic formats
  • Collect laboratory samples and perform lab testing in accordance with established policies and procedures, as well as COLA and CLIA regulations
  • Maintain an adequate supply of all reagents and consumables to perform quality testing
  • Perform all routine daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic maintenance and function checks following established protocol for all imaging equipment
  • Perform Quality Control as established by this laboratory
  • Perform Proficiency Testing and/or Split Sample analysis periodically as established by this facility
  • Retain records of all analytic activities performed for a minimum of two years
  • Perform all Quality Assessment activities assigned to this position and document these activities for periodic review by the Laboratory Supervisor and/or the Laboratory Director

Other Job Functions

  • Perform duties as ER Technician as needed
  • Maintain an adequate supply of all reagents and consumables to perform quality testing
  • Perform all routine daily, weekly, monthly, and periodic maintenance and function checks following established protocol for all imaging equipment

  • Attend staff meetings or other company sponsored or mandated meetings as required

Basic Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED, required

  • Associate’s degree in Radiology, preferred
  • Certified as a medical radiologic technologist as required by the state in which practicing required
  • Registered Technologist with the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) in radiography required

  • 2+ years radiologic/imaging experience, preferred
  • 1+ years of CT experience, preferred
  • 1+ years of emergency room experience, preferred
  • Proficiency with most X-ray/CT equipment, manufacturer’s hardware/software and PACS

title: Geospatial Database Administrator
description:
Overview

The Geospatial Database Administrator (GDBA) specializes in PostgreSQL and Oracle database management to support geospatial data systems critical to Air Force missions. The GDBA is responsible for maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of geospatial databases, with a focus on implementing Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) quarterly. The role also includes leading efforts to migrate Oracle databases to PostgreSQL, ensuring compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) standards.

Work Environment:

  • Location: Scott Air Force Base - Belleville, IL (This is not a remote position)
  • Security Clearance: Must hold or be eligible to obtain a Secret or higher-level security clearance.
  • Travel < 20% of the time

NV5 is a global technology solutions and consulting services company with a workforce of over 4,500 professionals in more than 100 offices worldwide. NV5’s continued growth has been spurred through strategic investments in firms with unique capabilities to help current and future customers solve the world’s toughest problems. The NV5 family brings together talent across a wide range of markets and fields, including Professional Engineers, Professional Land Surveyors, Architects, Photogrammetrists, GIS Professionals, Software Developers, IT, Project Management Professionals, and more.

At NV5 Geospatial, We are a collaboration of intelligent, innovative thinkers who care for each other, our communities, and the environment. We value both heart and head, the diversity of our people, and their experiences because that is how we continue to grow as a leader in our industry and expand our individual and collective potential.

Responsibilities

Database Management:

  • Design, develop, and maintain PostgreSQL databases with PostGIS extensions for geospatial data.
  • Administer Oracle databases and ensure compatibility and interoperability with existing systems.
  • Manage database configurations, indexing, and optimization for performance and scalability.
  • Lead migration efforts from Oracle to PostgreSQL, including planning, execution, and post-migration support.

Geospatial Data Administration:

  • Work with Data Manager to develop and execute complex spatial queries and scripts to support mission needs.
  • Ensure geospatial databases comply with metadata standards, such as FGDC or ISO 19115.

Migration Expertise:

  • Conduct assessments of existing Oracle databases and develop migration strategies.
  • Create tools and scripts to automate data migration processes between Oracle and PostgreSQL.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data compatibility and performance issues during migrations.

System and Security Administration:

  • Ensure compliance with Air Force cybersecurity and data security standards.
  • Perform database backups, disaster recovery planning, and regular system updates.
  • Work closely with analysts, engineers, and IT teams to align geospatial systems with operational goals.

STIG Implementation and Security Compliance:

  • Apply, configure, and validate Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) quarterly to ensure database systems meet DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, risk analysis, and mitigation for PostgreSQL and Oracle databases.
  • Document and report compliance statuses and remediation efforts.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address findings from security audits and inspections.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Equivalent experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
  • Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL with experience in database design and performance tuning.
  • Proficiency in Oracle database administration, with experience supporting geospatial data.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating Oracle databases to PostgreSQL, including resolving compatibility issues.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining STIG compliance for databases.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL, PL/pgSQL, or PL/SQL) for data processing.

Preferred (in addition to requirements):

  • Advanced knowledge of PostGIS, with experience in database design and performance tuning.
  • Active DoD Secret clearance.
  • Relevant certifications such as PostgreSQL Certified Developer or Oracle Certified Professional are a plus.
  • Understanding of Air Force operations and geospatial requirements is preferred.
  • Security certifications like CompTIA Security+ or CISSP are advantageous.

Competencies & Skills:

  • Expertise in geospatial data standards, formats, and models.
  • Proven ability to manage large-scale database migrations and optimize geospatial data workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot database issues effectively.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for cross-team efforts.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and drug screening.

description:
Schedule/Availability Flexible availability required. Shifts may include weekends, holidays, and early mornings/late afternoons to support site turns, events, and peak occupancy. Overtime may be required during high-volume periods or after severe weather.

Property Ambassador – Island Oaks RV Resort

Join Our Team!

Our mission as Grounds Ambassadors is to create a clean, safe, and welcoming environment where guests can relax, have fun, and make lasting memories. As a Grounds Ambassador, you are the eyes and ears of the resort-the friendly face guests rely on and the team member who helps protect the property's appearance, safety, and functionality. From a facilities perspective, you support day-to-day site readiness, common-area upkeep, and fast-response service that keeps the resort operating smoothly.

This is a hands-on, fast-paced role for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys being outdoors, and thrives on variety. Every day brings something new-turning RV sites, refreshing amenities, responding to guest requests, and proactively addressing cleanliness and safety issues before they become problems. You'll partner closely with Maintenance/Facilities, Housekeeping, and Guest Services to keep the resort guest-ready during peak arrival/departure times and high-occupancy weekends.

You'll work outdoors in all weather conditions, walking the property for extended periods and completing physical tasks that support resort facilities-trash and debris removal, light cleaning, resetting guest-use features (grills/fire pits), reporting maintenance issues, and helping ensure roads, pathways, and amenity areas are safe and presentable.

Position Summary

As a Grounds Ambassador, you support resort facilities operations by maintaining site readiness, cleanliness, and safety across an RV camping resort while serving as an on-site hospitality specialist. You complete continuous property rounds, provide valet-style trash service, reset RV sites and guest-use amenities, and promptly report hazards or maintenance needs. In collaboration with Guest Services, Housekeeping, and Maintenance/Facilities, you also help guide guests throughout their stay-answering questions, assisting with arrivals when needed, and ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to exceptional service.

Key Responsibilities

    • Provide valet-style trash service and routine waste runs, keeping guest areas clean, odor-free, and inviting; properly use trash compactor/dumpster areas per safety guidelines
    • Maintain overall resort cleanliness by collecting litter, clearing debris, and monitoring curb appeal across sites, roadways, landscaping edges, and amenity zones
    • Turn RV sites during departures/arrivals: remove trash, rake/spot-sweep pads, check fire pit/grill condition, reset picnic tables, and ensure the site looks guest-ready
    • Clean and maintain dog parks and pet stations (waste bag dispensers, receptacles, water stations as applicable) to ensure a safe and pleasant environment
    • Ensure grills and fire pits are cleaned, cooled, stocked, and ready for the next guest; report damage or missing components and remove hazards immediately
    • Assist with propane exchanges/refills (as assigned) and set up/refresh guest-use amenities (chairs, games, shade umbrellas, event equipment) based on daily needs
    • Monitor roads and pathways for safety issues (spills, potholes, trip hazards, low lighting, standing water) and report work orders to Facilities/Maintenance
    • Support amenity-area readiness by checking high-traffic locations (pool deck, restrooms, laundry, lakefront, playground, pavilion) for cleanliness, supply levels, and basic functionality
    • Operate basic grounds equipment safely (leaf blowers, pressure washer, weed eater, hand tools) and follow PPE and chemical-handling expectations when applicable
    • Monitor speeds throughout the resort to promote a safe environment for all guests (vehicles, golf carts, e-bikes, scooters, etc.); address concerns respectfully and escalate repeat issues per policy
    • Actively observe the park to identify and address safety concerns or guest needs; respond quickly to spills, broken glass, and other immediate hazards
    • Serve as a visible, approachable presence for guests-answering questions, providing directions, assisting with minor needs, and routing service requests to the right team
    • Document and communicate issues discovered during rounds (damage, vandalism, wildlife concerns, lost/found items, rule violations) to leadership and relevant departments
    • Support team operations with quick turnaround of tasks and readiness for high-demand periods; assist with special projects and event setup/breakdown
    • Jump in wherever needed to keep park operations running smoothly while maintaining a guest-first, safety-first mindset

    Guest Services & Arrival Support (as assigned) In some periods or at some locations, Property Ambassadors may provide additional guest-service coverage to support peak arrivals and resort flow:

    • Welcome guests warmly and use guest names whenever possible; provide directions, wayfinding, and basic resort orientation
    • Support check-in/check-out flow as needed by confirming reservation details, reviewing notes/special requests, and coordinating site assignments with Guest Services
    • Conduct site readiness checks and pre-arrival inspections to verify brand standards are met before guests are escorted to their site
    • Provide personalized tours and explain resort amenities, activities, quiet hours, pet policies, and safety expectations
    • Respond to guest inquiries in person, by phone, or via email with professionalism and urgency; route requests to the appropriate department
    • Use service recovery techniques when appropriate and escalate guest concerns promptly to leadership
    • Communicate with internal teams using radio, email, and Microsoft Teams to ensure seamless, coordinated service
    • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by management to support resort operations

Requirements

  • Friendly, professional demeanor in all interactions.
  • Flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work rotating shifts as needed.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Calm under pressure and knowledgeable about emergency procedures.
  • Excellent communication skills and adaptability.
  • Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods and lift up to 30 lbs.
  • Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to operate golf carts and motor vehicles.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This role is primarily outdoors and includes exposure to heat, humidity, rain, and seasonal weather conditions. Requires standing/walking for long periods, bending, reaching, pushing/pulling, and lifting up to 50 lbs. Must be comfortable working around vehicles, golf carts, and guests in active recreation areas. May require use of PPE and safe handling of cleaning products and equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in campground/RV resort operations, housekeeping, landscaping, or facilities;

  • familiarity with basic grounds tools; and comfort using a mobile device for checklists, photos, and communication.

  • Valid driver's license may be required based on property policy.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Previous front desk or guest services experience in a luxury setting.
  • Bilingual skills are a plus.

title: Senior Project Manager, Water/Wastewater Treatment

description:

Advisors build supportive and personalized relationships with students, manage their day-to-day expectations, and provide them with opportunities to stay connected to our online community. title: Director of Community Engagement
description:
The Director of Community Engagement cultivates and strengthens meaningful relationships between Cannon School and its alumni and families. Reporting to the Chief Advancement Officer and working closely with the Alumni Board and Parents at Cannon (PAC), the Director of Community Engagement serves as a thoughtful and trusted point of connection for alumni, current and former parents, grandparents, special friends, and other members of the Cannon community.

The heart of this role is relationship-building. Through thoughtful, person-to-person outreach; active listening; consistent follow-through; meaningful programs and events; and opportunities for involvement, the Director of Community Engagement helps foster lifelong connection, affinity, advocacy, and philanthropic partnership with Cannon.

The successful candidate will bring genuine care and curiosity to relationships, with the ability to listen deeply, understand differing perspectives, and respond with warmth, empathy, discretion, and sound judgment. The Director of Community Engagement helps constituents feel heard, valued, respected, and connected to Cannon and serves as a trusted bridge between alumni and families and School leadership, particularly during periods of change, uncertainty, or differing perspectives.

The Director of Community Engagement also contributes to Cannon School's five-year Strategic Vision initiative, "Develop a Community Partnership and Engagement Framework," particularly as it relates to alumni and family relationships. Working with the Chief Advancement Officer and Advancement colleagues, the Director of Community Engagement helps implement strategies that strengthen relationships and build a culture of philanthropy among families, alumni, and community partners while contributing constituent perspectives and insights to the broader direction of the Advancement Office.

While the role includes program, event, volunteer, and administrative responsibilities, its primary purpose is to cultivate trust, connection, and lifelong affinity for Cannon.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Alumni & Family Relations

  • Cultivate and maintain meaningful relationships with Cannon alumni, current and former parents, grandparents, special friends, and other members of the Cannon community.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for alumni and families, responding to questions and concerns with thoughtfulness, professionalism, and appropriate follow-through.
  • Proactively connect with constituents through person-to-person outreach, demonstrating genuine care and interest in their experiences, perspectives, and connection to Cannon.
  • Listen actively and attentively to constituent questions, concerns, ideas, and experiences, helping individuals feel heard, respected, and valued.
  • Serve as a thoughtful bridge between alumni and families and Cannon's leadership by facilitating communication, sharing constituent perspectives, and helping create opportunities for constructive dialogue and relationship-building.
  • Approach complex or sensitive conversations with empathy, curiosity, discretion, and sound judgment, helping preserve trust and maintain positive relationships even when perspectives differ.
  • Help strengthen continuity and connection among alumni and families during periods of institutional change or transition.
  • Support the transition of current students and families into lifelong members of the Cannon alumni community.

Alumni & Family Programs, Events & Volunteers

  • Plan and coordinate alumni and family programs and events that strengthen relationships and foster lifelong connection to Cannon, including Homecoming, Reunions, Distinguished Alumni Award Ceremony, Athletic Hall of Fame, Grandparents or Special Friends Day, and other campus and regional alumni and family events.
  • Manage the logistics and execution of assigned programs and events, including timelines, invitations, registration, vendors, communications, volunteers, event materials, and follow-up.
  • Serve as a liaison to the Alumni Board and Parents at Cannon (PAC), supporting effective communication, meetings, volunteer coordination, and leadership transitions.
  • Build positive and trusting relationships with alumni and parent volunteers, helping them feel informed, valued, supported, and connected to Cannon's mission and priorities.
  • Identify meaningful opportunities for alumni and families to contribute through volunteerism, mentorship, advocacy, and participation.

Advancement & Strategic Initiatives

  • Partner with the Advancement Team to strengthen constituent relationships and create pathways from connection and participation to advocacy and philanthropic partnership.
  • Support donor and prospect events and other Advancement activities that require thoughtful constituent relations, event planning, and relationship support.
  • Help alumni and families understand the impact of philanthropy and the ways their support strengthens the Cannon experience and advances the School's mission.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of Cannon's Community Partnership and Engagement Framework, particularly as it relates to alumni and family relationships and opportunities for participation, volunteerism, advocacy, and philanthropy.
  • Bring constituent perspectives, relationship insights, and programmatic knowledge to the Advancement Office's strategic planning and efforts to strengthen Cannon's culture of philanthropy.
  • Help cultivate a network of alumni and family advocates who understand and support Cannon's mission, values, and strategic priorities and who are willing to champion the School within the broader community.

Communications & Collaboration

  • Maintain a calendar of alumni and family programs, events, and communications.
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications colleagues to develop timely and thoughtful communications that inform alumni and families about opportunities to connect with and support Cannon.
  • Help share compelling Cannon stories and constituent experiences that strengthen affinity, pride, and connection among alumni and families.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Cannon—including Advancement, Admission, Arts, Athletics, College Counseling, and the Office of Diversity, Belongingness and Engagement—to support shared institutional priorities while maintaining clear responsibility for alumni and family relations within Advancement.
  • Contribute to strategic enrollment management initiatives by connecting current families and supporting opportunities to welcome and connect prospective families with the Cannon community.

Administration & Database Management

  • Maintain accurate and timely records of constituent interactions, event participation, volunteer involvement, and other relevant relationship information in the School's database.
  • Manage role-specific budget line and ensure responsible stewardship of resources.
  • Maintain accurate calendars, contact information, event records, and other administrative information necessary to support effective constituent relations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of the Advancement Office and the mission of Cannon School.

title: Production AI Innovation Lead (Contract, Remote)
description:
OUR HIRING PROCESS:

  • We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment.
  • We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team.
  • At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team.
  • From there on, it’s decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live.

    INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy

INFUSE is a demand generation company providing solutions to B2B organizations. We help clients and partners to deliver audience, buyers, and account engagement that meets their goals. With a global team operating across more than 60 countries, the company has been recognized multiple times on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list, and has received over 60 other industry awards, including Inc. Best Workplaces.

At INFUSE Academy, we build learning experiences that work. We are looking for someone who sits at the intersection of design craft and AI experimentation -- a person who does not wait to be handed a process but builds one, tests it until it holds, and then scales it across the team.

This is not a traditional design role. It is part R&D, part operations, part education.

What you will bring:

  • Proficiency in Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop
  • Solid foundation in composition, typography, and color theory
  • Experience with data visualization and visual storytelling
  • A genuine AI enthusiasm: you follow the space, you experiment independently, and you think in systems
  • Ability to move from testing to documentation to teaching without losing momentum
  • Strong self-organization -- you can run an open-ended initiative with minimal direction

What you will do:

  • Research and test AI tools relevant to learning content production
  • Refine workflows until output quality meets the bar, then document and standardize them
  • Train the production team on new tools and processes you have validated
  • Build courses and learning assets using the workflows you develop
  • Own the full cycle: strategy, testing, operationalization, and delivery

What you’ll love about working with us:

  • A fun, diverse team of professionals from every corner of the globe
  • A never-ending learning journey (because who wants to stop growing?)
  • Career growth opportunities with regular reviews, your success is our success!
  • Timely, market-range compensation (we make sure your wallet’s happy, too)
  • Paid time off for U.S. public holidays, because rest is as important as work
  • Summer Fridays with shorter hours, because everyone deserves a little sunshine
  • Access to top-tier tools, so you can create like a pro

If you recognize yourself in this and are up to the challenge, we’d be happy to hear from you!

title: Oracle NetSuite Solution Consultant, Intelligent Finance & AI
description:
Who are we?

At Oracle NetSuite, our vision is to transform how businesses operate so they can achieve their business goals faster, smarter, and with greater confidence. As the world's leading cloud business management suite, NetSuite unifies ERP, financials, CRM, ecommerce, supply chain, planning, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities into a single platform that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing business environment.

Today, business leaders are looking beyond system modernization—they are seeking intelligent platforms that can help them predict outcomes, automate decisions, accelerate productivity, and unlock new growth opportunities. Through Oracle's investments in Artificial Intelligence, Enterprise Performance Management, Analytics, and Business Applications, we are helping customers reimagine how finance and operations teams work, make decisions, and drive business performance.

We are passionate about innovation, customer success, and creating lifelong advocates for NetSuite. Every interaction is an opportunity to help our customers realize greater value from their technology investments and achieve outcomes that transform their businesses.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for intellectually curious, business-minded innovators who are passionate about helping organizations solve complex challenges through technology. The ideal candidate combines financial expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling skills, and a genuine enthusiasm for emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and intelligent automation.

You thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy engaging with executives and business leaders, and are energized by uncovering opportunities to help customers operate more effectively. You are equally comfortable discussing financial planning processes with a CFO, AI-driven business transformation with a Chief Digital Officer, or solution architecture with technical stakeholders.

If you are motivated by continuous learning, innovation, customer impact, and the opportunity to shape the future of business applications and AI, this is the role for you.

Why is this an exciting opportunity?

As part of Oracle NetSuite's Sales Consulting Organization, the Senior Solution Consultant, Strategic Finance & AI plays a strategic role in helping customers envision and achieve the future of intelligent business operations. You will engage directly with prospects, existing customers, and channel partners to understand their business objectives, identify opportunities for transformation, and demonstrate how Oracle NetSuite's EPM, Analytics, and AI-powered solutions can deliver measurable business value.

This role goes beyond traditional product demonstrations. You will serve as a trusted advisor, helping organizations modernize planning, forecasting, reporting, and decision-making processes through innovative technologies such as predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows.

Working closely with executives, finance leaders, and operational stakeholders, you will guide customers through their transformation journey by connecting business challenges to strategic outcomes. You will help customers understand not only how Oracle solutions work, but how they can fundamentally change the way their organizations operate, compete, and grow.

This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of Oracle's AI strategy, influence high-impact business decisions, and help define the next generation of intelligent enterprise performance management.

Responsibilities

As a subject matter expert, the Senior Solution Consultant, Strategic Finance & AI provides strategic direction and specialized knowledge around Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), solutions related to a customer’s business and industry.

You will partner with finance leaders to reimagine how planning, forecasting, reporting, consolidation, and decision-making processes can be transformed through NetSuite’s EPM and AI-powered capabilities. Your objective is not only to demonstrate software functionality, but to help customers envision new ways of operating through predictive insights, automation, and intelligent decision support.

You will create and facilitate a vision for customers using executive presentations, solution workshops, demonstrations, benchmarks, and AI innovation sessions that showcase the “Power of Prediction.”

As an EPM Solution Consultant, you will:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, FP&A leaders, Controllers, Finance Transformation executives, and Line of Business stakeholders.

  • Lead discovery sessions focused on understanding business objectives, planning maturity, data challenges, operational inefficiencies, and AI readiness.

  • Design and deliver value-based demonstrations that connect NetSuite’s EPM, Analytics, and AI capabilities to measurable business value. Articulate the benefit of out of the box integration to NetSuite ERP as well as utilizing 3rd party data sources to support modeling

  • Translate complex customer requirements into solution strategies that leverage NetSuite’s AI-enabled planning, forecasting, reporting, and performance management capabilities.

  • Articulate the value of AI-driven finance transformation, including predictive planning, intelligent variance analysis, narrative reporting, forecasting optimization, and decision intelligence.

  • Partner with Account Executives to develop compelling business cases and executive-level value propositions.

  • Demonstrate Oracle NetSuite’s vision for autonomous finance operations through embedded AI, digital assistants, machine learning, and agentic workflows.

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to provide market feedback and influence future AI and EPM innovation.

  • Develop executive presentations and thought leadership content focused on modern finance, AI adoption, and business transformation.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

Responsible for the administration and execution of assigned projects in safe, profitable and timely manner. Often assigned multiple project and/or projects of larger contract amounts and/or complexity. Manages the work in a manner consistent with standards of quality and integrity. Establishes and maintains a professional working relationships with owners, architects, engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. Participate as requested in business development, estimating, bidding an contract negotiation phases of the projects assigned. This position includes two "steps" (I, II), which provide for a progression of skill and experience. The Step I level is capable of managing fairly large projects of $51 - $100 million in size with typically 10 - 15 years of experience. The Step II level is capable of managing large projects of a complex nature and/or multiple projects totaling $101 - $199 million and typically with a minimum of 15 years of experience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Champions the orderly, timely transition of projects from the estimating phase to the field. This transition shall include contract review meetings, which encompass a review of contract requirements, general conditions, schedules, budgets, subcontracts, and purchase order agreements.
2. Completes close out requirements and punch lists in a timely manner. Handles warranty callbacks quickly to maintain owner/client relationships.
3. Coordinates with the Project Superintendent the means and methods required for the successful and profitable execution of the work. Reviews and monitors manpower, equipment, and material resources to accomplish this goal.
4. Establishes and maintains professional working relationships with owners, architects, engineers, and subcontractors.
5. Has overall responsibility for project success, including safety, schedule, profitability, quality and customer satisfaction as well as responsibility for personnel decisions that impact the project.
6. Manages all billings to ensure timely submission of payment applications and collection of payments from the
7. Manages the development of the overall CPM schedule with the Project Superintendent(s) and assures all procurement is fully coordinated with the Project Engineer(s). Ensures the project team is utilizing the Last Planner System (LPS) to manage all schedules.
8. Participates in preparation and review of estimates with attention to the following: adherence to cost control system, equipment requirements and utilization, constructability, formwork, materials, manpower, general conditions, schedule, insurance, etc.
9. Participates in the business development process including client contact, relationships, proposals, presentations, and negotiations for selected projects.
10. Prepares the Monthly Progress Report in coordination with the Superintendent(s) by the 6th of every month. Uses available reports to manage costs and prepare accurate cost projections.
11. Responsible for the timely review of purchase orders and subcontracts prepared by the estimating department.
12. Responsible for understanding and administering prime contract terms and conditions, contract documents, subcontract agreements, purchase order agreements, insurance, etc. This includes providing written notifications when necessary to document impacts.
13. Reviews and executes all change orders, supplements, and cost control budget adjustments.
14. Verifies agreements are executed with insurance in place prior to any subcontractor starting work onsite.

Minimum Job Requirements

1. Experience in Pre-Con managing construction projects, thorough knowledge of contract documents, materials, equipment utilization, scheduling systems, productivity analysis, construction operations, cash flow procedures.
2. Four year construction related degree or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience.
3. Proficient use of all Microsoft Office Suite programs.

Note: Job Description is subject to change at any time and may include other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

1. Ability to wear personal protective equipment is required (including but not limited to; steel toed shoes, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, hardhat, vest, etc.)
2. May reach above shoulder heights and below the waist on a frequent basis
3. May stoop, kneel, or bend, on an occasional basis
4. May use telephone, computer system, email, or other electronic devices on a limited basis to communicate with internal and external customers or vendors
5. Must be able to comply with all safety standards and procedures
6. Occasionally will climb stairs, ladders, etc.
7. Required to use hands to grasp, lift, handle, carry or feel objects on a frequent basis
8. Will interact with people frequently during a shift/work day
9. Will lift, push or pull objects on an occasional basis
10. Will sit, stand or walk short distances for up to the entire duration of a shift/work day.

Safety Level

Safety-Sensitive

Note: Jobs with the Safety-Sensitive designation are those that include tasks or duties that the employer reasonably believes could affect the safety and health of the employee performing the task or others such as operating a vehicle, operating equipment, operating machinery or power tools, repairing/maintaining the operation of any vehicle/equipment, the handling/disposal/transport of hazardous materials, or the handling/treatment/disposal of potentially flammable/combustible materials.

title: SOF Desk Officer
description:
The Ascendancy Group’s Mission

To be the unequaled provider of special operations forces (SOF) and Intelligence Community focused technical, service, and training-based solutions.


Overview

As a SOF Desk Officer, you will provide SA case management support and HUMINT technical oversight to 1st Special Forces Command and ARSOF Sensitive Activities Mission Management Cells (SAMMC) in accordance with Intelligence Community, Service, and Joint SOF policies and procedures. You will support the planning and execution of SA core competencies, manage case documentation and intelligence reporting, and monitor security, risk, and operational controls to protect personnel and missions. You will coordinate with Intelligence Community and Joint Force partners, advise operational personnel on SA activities, and support the integration of Multi-Domain Intelligence to enhance case execution, operational planning, and mission effects. You will also assist in the employment of sensitive capabilities and contribute to risk management throughout the operations cycle.


Security Requirement:

  • Current Top Secret/Specialized Compartmented Information Security Clearance.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Serves as a SOF Desk Officer.
  • Provide support for dataflow management requests and support teams.
  • Serve as an advisor on internal and external requirements policies, processes, and procedures.
  • Review HUMINT operational reporting and the processing of Intelligence Community standard formats and inputs.
  • Ensure compliance with local Major Command (MACOM) and Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) specified policies and guidance.
  • Assist SA and HUMINT case management as focal point for operational reporting.
  • Maintain reporting metrics to support the SAMMC mission.
  • Utilize intelligence tools for qualitative review of platform/collector performance.
  • Support monthly reporting of HUMINT reporting metrics.
  • Monitor and track requirements documentation actions.
  • Implement efficient data management processes, ensuring data quality and integrity, and facilitating seamless retrieval and analysis of information.
  • Solicit, analyze, document, and facilitate prioritization and validation of analyst needs.
  • Provides consistent real-time updates of collection and planned collection requirements through existing databases.

title: Lead Psychiatrist, Outpatient Pediatric Services PT
description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra Health is looking for an accomplished clinical leader with proven expertise and commitment to evidence-based, culturally responsive care, clinical quality assurance, and the development of high-performing teams.   • Strategic Contribution:

  • Contribute to company-wide initiatives focused on innovation and growth

Best Workplaces.

At INFUSE Academy, we build learning experiences that work. We are looking for someone who sits at the intersection of design craft and AI experimentation -- a person who does not wait to be handed a process but builds one, tests it until it holds, and then scales it across the team.

  • Proficiency in Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop
  • Solid foundation in composition, typography, and color theory
  • Experience with data visualization and visual storytelling
  • A genuine AI enthusiasm: you follow the space, you experiment independently, and you think in systems
  • Ability to move from testing to documentation to teaching without losing momentum
  • Strong self-organization -- you can run an open-ended initiative with minimal direction

What you will do:

  • Research and test AI tools relevant to learning content production
  • Refine workflows until output quality meets the bar, then document and standardize them
  • Train the production team on new tools and processes you have validated
  • Build courses and learning assets using the workflows you develop
  • Own the full cycle: strategy, testing, operationalization, and delivery

What you’ll love about working with us:

  • A fun, diverse team of professionals from every corner of the globe
  • A never-ending learning journey (because who wants to stop growing?)
  • Career growth opportunities with regular reviews, your success is our success!
  • Timely, market-range compensation (we make sure your wallet’s happy, too)
  • Paid time off for U.S. public holidays, because rest is as important as work
  • Summer Fridays with shorter hours, because everyone deserves a little sunshine
  • Access to top-tier tools, so you can create like a pro

If you recognize yourself in this and are up to the challenge, we’d be happy to hear from you!

title: Production Operators and Fabricator positions
description:
At Clopay Corporation, we are more than just North America’s largest residential and commercial garage door manufacturer—we are a powerhouse of innovation, safety, and design. Through our premier brands, we lead the industry in providing groundbreaking high-performance closure solutions for both the places people call home and the spaces where the world does business.


Headquartered in Mason, Ohio, and operating state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Troy, Ohio, Mountaintop, Pennsylvania, and Goodyear, Arizona, we are a proud American-owned company and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Griffon Corporation. Our reach extends across 55+ distribution centers and thousands of retail locations in the U.S. and Canada, ensuring that we deliver the right door for every opening – from homes to businesses and beyond.

By joining our team, you become part of a legacy that blends the residential elegance of Clopay, known as "America’s Favorite Garage Doors," with the industrial strength and 180-year heritage of our rolling brands, Cornell and Cookson. Together, we secure everything from family garages to the world's most iconic stadiums and skyscrapers.


We currently have the following openings in our Mountaintop, PA Manufacturing Facility

We are seeking outstanding, highly motivated and energetic candidates to join our growing team on all shifts.


We are looking to fill positions in :

  • Powder Coat Load/Unload (Packer)- 3rd Shift
  • Lifting 0-50 lbs parts on a repetitive basis / Load conveyor system masimizing available sq. footage of the line / unload and correctly tag product / taking product to proper department after coating
  • Shipping Associate (Material Handler) - 3rd Shift
  • Accurately retrieve product by job number and stage material in a variety of locations / safe operation of overhead crane / Utilize RF scan gun and computer to track and complete movement of material being shipped.
  • Folder Operator (Machine Operator) - 1st Shift
  • Work with computer prgrams to properly bgend sheet metal / Form square hoos to exact description on the shop sheets / Apply proper cut outs to sheet metal / Measure to ensure length & width is correct / move to packing area.
  • Motor Service Technician (Fabricator) - 1st Shift
  • Modify and or convert Cornell, Leftmaster, and McKeon Operators as needed / Works with Receiving, Engineering, Service and Shipping / Works with Purchasing to verify parts and motors due dates, order status, and re-use of RMA operators.
  • Curtain Wrapper (Packager)- 4M Shift
  • Move 7ft pcs of tri-wall cardboard from stack to automated forming machine / Feed through the forming machine and place forded cardboard in wrapping cradels/ Cut with bandsaw / Save use of overhead crane / Nylon banding around package / write job number and truck letters on package
  • Hood Packing (Packager) - 2nd Shift
  • Placing of all product needed to complete a job into a box / Print lavles denoting what is in each box / apply shipping lavels and mark tags / Apply baffle strip to hood using staple machine / Cut brush as required using circular saw.


Our new team members are starting at $20.00 to $23.69 with an additional shift differential of $1.50 /hour for working 2nd or 3rd shift and $2.00/hour for 4th shift

1st Shift 7:00 am to 3:00 pm

2nd Shift 3:00 pm to 11:00 pm

3rd Shift 11:00 pm to 7:00 am

4F Shift (Fri-Sat-Sunday) 7:00 am to 7:00 pm 4M Shift (Sat-Sun-Monday) 7:00 am to 7:00



Qualifications include:

  • Qualified candidates must possess a High School diploma, must be able lift up to 50 pounds, and have the ability to work at a quick pace.
  • Previous experience working in a manufacturing facility.
  • Understand, interpret and utilize blueprints / drawings
  • Ability to use hand tools and read a tape measure with accuracy
  • Computer knowledge
  • Meet Safety, Production and Quality standards


Why Choose a Career With Us?

We don't just manufacture doors; we engineer the "front door" of the American dream and the security of global commerce. At Clopay, we believe our strength lies in our people. From our design engineers to our manufacturing associates and delivery drivers, every member of the team plays a vital role in our success.

Our team members thrive because we prioritize:


  • Unrivaled Scale: Work for a market leader with a massive manufacturing footprint and a reputation for excellence that spans nearly two centuries.
  • A Culture of "What’s Next": We invest heavily in automation, sustainable materials, and smart-home integration to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Commitment to People: As a Griffon Corporation company, we provide the stability of a large organization with the tight-knit, collaborative feel of a specialized craft team.
  • A Legacy of Expertise: Join our "Pioneer Club"—a group of over 440 employees who have been with us for 20 years or more. We offer the stability of a market leader and a place where you can truly grow a lifelong career.
  • Commitment to Innovation: We aren’t just keeping up with industry trends; we’re setting them. Whether it’s our exclusive WINDCODE® technology or our award-winning designs, we provide the tools for you to do your best work.
  • Community Focused: Our success is linked to the well-being of our neighbors and communities. Through our partnership with Habitat for Humanity, Clopay employees help provide homes and security to families in the communities where we live and work.

title: Senior HR Technology Leader
description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.

Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America's boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country's biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.

As the Senior HR Technology Product Manager, you will serve as the strategic technology partner for Stand Together’s broader people technology landscape — bringing structure, clarity, and forward momentum to how we leverage our HRIS (UKG) and supporting systems across the full Talent function, including recruiting, learning, performance, reporting, and related people systems.

Success in this role is rooted in partnership — working alongside HR Leadership and IT to shape platform strategy, improve system health, and ensure HR technology decisions are made with intention and architectural rigor. You will bring enterprise application expertise and principled product thinking to a domain that is partially built and ready for focused leadership.

This role sits at the intersection of People, Enterprise Applications, and Data — translating HR priorities into clear system strategies, governance frameworks, and execution plans that reduce friction and enable the People function to scale.

How You Will Contribute

  • Serve as the primary IT partner for HR technology, connecting HR leadership and Enterprise IT to build a shared platform strategy and roadmap

  • Assess and stabilize the current state of the HR technology ecosystem, identifying gaps, clarifying ownership, and building a clear path forward

  • Define and maintain clear point-of-view (POV) documentation for HR systems and the broader technology landscape

  • Establish and run a single intake and prioritization model for HR technology work, ensuring the roadmap reflects the right priorities across HR and IT stakeholders

  • Translate recurring system pain points into structured improvement opportunities, and coordinate changes, testing, and releases with clear communication to all affected stakeholders

  • Partner with Enterprise IT teams (Enterprise Apps, Enterprise Data) and other shared services, including Accounting/Finance and Infrastructure, to align HR system and data architecture solutions as needed

  • Ensure HR technology decisions are aligned with data reliability, analytics, and AI enablement initiatives

  • Apply IT best practices and enterprise application governance principles to bring consistency and reliability to the HR technology environment

What You Will Bring

  • Experience owning or managing enterprise technology platforms such as ERP, HRIS, or comparable application ecosystems

  • A technical foundation that informs product thinking. You understand how systems are built, not just how they are used

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business needs into system strategy, governance frameworks, and execution plans

  • Experience working cross-functionally across business stakeholders, IT, and data teams, comfortable operating at the intersection of all three

  • Proven ability to assess, stabilize, and improve partially built or inherited technology implementations

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and exercising principled judgment in a fast-moving environment

  • Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together's vision and approach to solving problems, with a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values that include transformation, innovation, entrepreneurship, humility, and respect

Standout Candidates Will Bring

  • Background spanning technical delivery and product management. You have built things and owned things.

  • Familiarity with UKG, Workday, ADP, or comparable HRIS platforms. Domain exposure is helpful context, not the primary differentiator. Strong people-systems expertise exists internally, and this knowledge can be built on the job

  • Experience implementing governance models, RACI frameworks, or prioritization frameworks in a complex stakeholder environment

  • Working knowledge of how enterprise systems connect, including data flows, integrations, or cloud platforms, and comfort asking the right questions of technical partners

  • Familiarity with Koch companies or Principle Based Management is a plus, though not required

What We Offer

  • Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace.

  • A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,400 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges.

  • Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents.

title: Sr. Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer
description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




THE ROLE:

As a Sr. Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer in our Networking Technology & Solutions Group (NTSG), you will be responsible for ensuring that AMD’s next-generation products deliver industry-leading reliability, performance, and efficiency. This role involves designing, analyzing, modeling and validating complex systems with high-speed channels and high-power components.

THE PERSON:

In this role, you will closely collaborate with Silicon IP team, ASIC packaging team, PCB design team, System Architect and external partners/suppliers to meet the most demanding signal/power integrity requirements while ensuring manufacturability.

KEY RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Model and simulate the end-to-end high-speed channels including transceivers, IC package, PCB and cross-boards connectors/cables
  • Utilize industry-standard tools and methodologies to perform a variety of time/frequency domain signal integrity analysis (IBIS-AMI, SPICE, full-wave EM analysis, etc.)
  • Identify the link quality such as loss, reflection and crosstalk, and resolve the issues
  • Conduct channel-simulations to optimize Eye Diagram, Bit Error Rate (BER) and Signal-Noise-Ratio (SNR) for high-speed signaling across complex systems
  • Perform Channel Operation Margin (COM) analysis to validate the channel health for IEEE compliance
  • Excise Design of Experiments (DOE) sweeping to statistically evaluate the signal integrity qualities across process variations, like silicon corners, trace impedance, routing length, terminations, etc.
  • Interpret the simulation results to provide the design guidelines on board materials, stack-up, transmission line routings, component placement and layout optimization
  • Work on critical circuits (especially reference clocks and high-speed signals) to ensure signal integrity and power integrity
  • Drive PCB physical design, create PCB stack-up, generate PCB design rules, review PCB layout, identify the potential signal integrity and power integrity issues, and propose solutions
  • Support lab validation and debugging to correlate with the simulation data
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product development while keeping projects on schedule and within scope.
  • Stay at the forefront of signal integrity and power integrity innovations and high-speed design technologies, ensuring that AMD continues to lead the industry

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in high-speed signal integrity and power integrity engineering fields
  • Strong background in PCB and package design for signal integrity and power integrity
  • Strong expertise in high-speed architecture, interconnects and PCB/package design
  • Deep knowledge of high-speed interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, etc.)
  • Proficiency in SI/PI simulation tools (Keysight ADS, Cadence Sigrity, Ansys HFSS)
  • Familiarity with MATLAB or Python for data analysis and automation

title: Midwest Correspondent, National
description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times National desk is seeking an ambitious and creative correspondent to cover the Midwest, working closely with the Chicago Bureau Chief.

You are well-sourced in the state and should be experienced covering everything that makes the region tick – including its people, politics, identity, eccentricities and weather. You have a strong understanding of the region and can unearth revealing and surprising stories for readers in the area and beyond.

You write quickly, clearly and accurately on deadline. Writing in a variety of formats and embracing new forms of storytelling is essential.

This is a remote position based in the Midwest.

Responsibilities:

  • You will produce a portfolio of work that ranges from breaking news stories to enterprise, accountability pieces and scoops, and embraces a variety of story formats and collaborations — that as a body of work help readers understand your region.
  • You will actively seek out newsworthy events, identify relevant sources, and conduct thorough research to gather information.
  • You will write clear, concise, and engaging news stories that adhere to journalistic style guidelines.
  • You will cultivate a deep source network of authorities, politicians, sheriffs, union reps, cultural figures, law enforcement, agency representatives and beyond – positioning yourself to tap a source in a given news moment, from scoops to interviews and real-time updates. You'll also discern which stories to write to further develop and engage your sources.
  • You will monitor news and deliver a steady stream of story ideas that help explain the region.
  • You will write with authority, clarity, and independence.
  • You will brainstorm and develop ideas with colleagues in your region or on adjacent beats, initiate collaborations when opportunities arise, and keep in regular contact with your fellow reporters and editors.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to a National Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years' experience at a journalism or media company or other relevant organization
  • Experience working in high-pressure, deadline-driven newsrooms
  • Strong reporting and writing skills that demonstrate mastery of journalistic style and standards, including ethical and superb news judgment
  • A portfolio that includes politics, news, enterprise and analysis

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A strong understanding of Times style and standards

title: Driver Services Representative
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Driver Services Representative to join our team in Orlando. This is an excellent entry-level opportunity to launch your career in freight brokerage and transportation logistics. In this role, you will be the vital link between our drivers, customers, and internal operations, ensuring seamless coordination and exceptional service delivery. You will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your organizational skills, communication abilities, and problem-solving mindset will directly impact customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. As you grow with us, you'll develop a comprehensive understanding of how freight brokerage operations work, from load management to shipment tracking, while supporting our drivers and customers with professionalism and empathy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  • Enter new load orders and shipment information into proprietary web-based software systems with accuracy and attention to detail, learning brokerage-specific processes and industry standards
  • Conduct proactive "check calls" to track and trace drivers throughout all pickups and deliveries, maintaining clear and transparent communication while building relationships with drivers
  • Coordinate internal correspondence with drivers to ensure accurate documentation and timely updates on shipment status, gaining hands-on experience in freight coordination
  • Monitor freight movement across multiple tracking platforms to verify accurate delivery times and proactively notify customers of potential delays
  • Collect, organize, and maintain proper documentation for each shipment, ensuring all records are complete and accessible while understanding the importance of documentation in brokerage operations
  • Collaborate with Sales and Dispatch teams to identify solutions for customer needs and resolve operational issues efficiently, learning how different departments work together in brokerage
  • Maintain consistent outbound call volume while prioritizing quality interactions and customer satisfaction
  • Respond to driver inquiries and customer concerns with empathy and professionalism, providing clear and concise information
  • Balance multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining organizational systems and meeting daily performance goals
  • Contribute to continuous process improvements by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting innovative solutions, while developing your understanding of freight brokerage best practices

**Required Qualifications:**

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 1-3 years of work experience in customer service, operations, data entry, call center, dispatch, or logistics
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy while managing multiple tasks
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Suite and web-based software applications
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, organize, and balance competing demands effectively
  • Strong teamwork and collaborative skills with the ability to work cross-functionally
  • Problem-solving abilities and resilience in fast-paced environments
  • Time management skills and ability to meet performance targets
  • Knowledge of tracking and tracing systems or willingness to learn quickly

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  • Associate's degree or higher
  • Previous call center or customer service experience
  • Familiarity with logistics, transportation, or dispatch operations
  • Experience with driver communication and coordination
  • Knowledge of freight management or shipment documentation processes

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
Overview

Join us as we Rise to the Challenge

Employee ownership fosters an entrepreneurial spirit, encourages technical expertise, and shapes strategic planning.

We understand that you have choices, and we know that together we will make a great team!
